$comment: v0.6 Hyper-V PoC machine-readable result. Raw canary outcomes are mapped by verify.mjs (classify) to ALLOWED|DENIED|PASS|FAIL|UNKNOWN; the verdict is computed by evaluator.mjs. NOT_RUN and timeout are UNKNOWN and NEVER promoted to PASS. No secrets/credential values/unrelated paths — bounded labels only.
verdict: PASS | FAIL | INCOMPLETE (computed by evaluator.mjs, never manual)

network.$comment: measured from INSIDE the worker with raw sockets (A..H + DNS). raw outcome: connected|refused|blocked|no-route|reset|unreachable|answered|timeout|not_run
network.hostOtherPort: NOT_RUN (D: other port on the broker host IP — must be DENIED)
network.hostOtherAddress: NOT_RUN (D: unrelated host interface — must be DENIED)
network.rawSocketBypass: NOT_RUN (H: raw TCP ignoring proxy env — must be DENIED)
network.dnsGateway: NOT_RUN (UDP/53 to the gateway — must be DENIED)

broker.$comment: measured on the HOST (the trusted broker), I and J
broker.brokerProviderRoute: NOT_RUN (I: broker -> synthetic provider upstream — must be ALLOWED)
broker.unauthorizedDestinationThroughBroker: NOT_RUN (J: broker refuses another destination — must be DENIED)

policy.networkType: the Docker/HNS network type actually used

environment.$comment: env NAMES only, never values; a synthetic (fake) credential is the only secret-shaped material, and it must not escape the worker
